description: Flows whose `different` verdict is a deliberate, documented divergence from the legacy baseline (CONTRACT.md section 6). A divergence is accepted only when every difference reason starts with one of its `accept` prefixes (status changes are never accepted); any other `different` flow fails TranscriptParityTests. An entry that matches again is reported in the parity report so it can be removed.

mvc-unknown-path.reason: Unmapped URL: status 404 matches; the legacy body is the host-generated Mono/xsp4 HttpException error page (Mono version + stack trace), which ASP.NET Core does not reproduce (empty 404). R5 only makes >=500 bodies opaque.

mvc-api-root-undiscovered.reason: /api stays 404 (Q1, CatalogController2 never discovered); only the host-generated Mono 404 error page body differs, as for mvc-unknown-path.

mvc-pic-nonnumeric.reason: /items/abc/pic does not match items/{catalogItemId:int}/pic: status 404 matches; legacy body is the host-generated Mono 404 error page, as for mvc-unknown-path.

wf-unknown-path.reason: Unmapped URL: status 404 and content type match; the legacy body is the host-generated Mono/xsp4 HttpException error page (Mono version + stack trace), which the Razor Pages port does not reproduce verbatim.
